title: The Hidden Vendor
summary: The investigator starts from contract HP-2025-041, follows its Payment files link, and uses the listed subcontractor to inspect Northline Survey LLC in the company registry. The officer history identifies Daniel Price as controller, gives the registered unit address, and links to Calder Development’s staff directory, where Price is listed as Finance Director. Returning to the payment-file index, the contract reference opens the disputed invoice listing File ID INV-NS-7781. Retrieving it confirms Price approved a paid survey claim for 2025-09-14, while the attached inspection note says no survey crew attended that day. The invoice also exposes the registered address and an Open parking record control for the next level.

puzzles.title: Payment file index

inputs.use: The investigator finds HP-2025-041 on the contract result, understands it as the payment-file record selector, clicks Payment files, and enters it in the Contract reference field to open the contract’s payment index.
The investigator uses the controller’s name from Northline’s registry record to distinguish the Northline row whose approver matches the controller; no separate navigation is required.
The August Calder staff-directory title explains why the matching approver could authorize payment and confirms that the Northline row is the disputed internal approval.

puzzles.title: Paid invoice and inspection note
puzzles.purpose: Retrieve the disputed invoice, confirm its vendor, approver, service date, and paid status, and compare the claim with the attached inspection note showing no survey crew attended.

generationSpec.visibleBody: File ID: INV-NS-7781. Vendor: Northline Survey LLC. Registered address: 18 Mason Street, Unit 3. Contract: HP-2025-041. Service date: 2025-09-14. Approved by Daniel Price on 2025-09-15. Status: Paid. Attachment: inspection note for 2025-09-14. Public control: Open parking record.

verification.prompt: What does the attached 2025-09-14 inspection note say about the survey crew? Enter the short finding.

inputs.use: The investigator finds the File ID on the Northline row in Harbor Point’s payment index, understands it as the disputed invoice reference, and enters it in the File ID field on the payment-file retrieval form to open the invoice.
The investigator compares the full unit address from Northline’s registry filing with the address printed on the retrieved invoice to confirm both records concern the same vendor.

outputs.description: The inspection-note finding that contradicts Northline’s paid claim for survey work on 2025-09-14, supporting Maya’s allegation that the invoice was false.
The retrieved invoice’s visible Open parking record control carries the investigator to the next record using the invoice’s registered address and service date.

startingSituation: The contract result names Northline Survey LLC and shows “Payment files.” Open it, compare the vendor with the company registry, and enter the disputed invoice reference in the File ID field.

playerCapabilities: Retrieve a file by its File ID.
playerConstraints: Use only the provided public records.
Corroborate control through the officer record.
